verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is API-first. Its documented API covers writes (upsert, patch/delete by filter, conditional writes), branching, server-side copies, every query type, namespace listing and metadata. That includes what the dashboard offers for browsing documents and running queries. However, API tokens are documented only as created and expired in the dashboard, which suggests at least some admin functions are UI-only, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm parity. Missing for 10: API-based token/account management, a documented statement of UI-API parity, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
